_comment: A minimal Superchain Registry snapshot: enough to resolve a chain pair when
discovery cannot, and to print a block-explorer link.
Every bridge address below was DERIVED, not transcribed. Each row was
produced by running this tool's own discovery against the live chain on
2026-08-02: L2StandardBridge.otherBridge() on the rollup, then messenger()
and portal() on Ethereum Sepolia. A row is therefore a cached answer to the
same question discovery asks, which is the only kind of fallback worth
having: it cannot disagree with discovery without one of them being wrong.
Mainnet rows are deliberately absent. They could not be verified in the
session that wrote this file, and an unverified address in a fallback that
the tool sends ETH to is worse than no fallback at all. To add one, run
discovery against that chain and paste what it returns.
l1ChainId is part of the identity of a row: the same rollup ID paired with a
different L1 is a different deployment, and must not match.
